At each step you decide using only the evidence given, choose exactly one allowed action, explain why with the numbers, cite the rule, and say what happens next.

STAGE: optimization_reliability
Optimization and reliability, probability calibration: compare expected calibration error (ECE, 10 bins) of the raw model with sigmoid and isotonic calibration fitted inside the training folds. Calibrate only if raw ECE is above 0.03 AND the better method cuts ECE by at least 25% without losing more than 0.002 ROC-AUC. Prefer sigmoid when the training folds have fewer than 1,000 rows or isotonic is better by less than 0.005 ECE.

DATASET: Wine Quality (Binary) (wine_quality). Predicts whether a wine is rated quality 6 or higher.
DECISION MOMENT: Wine quality >=6 after physicochemical tests and before quality rating; wine-type/source subgroup information is missing from this legacy cache.
ROWS USED: 4,000 | FEATURES: 11 | POSITIVE RATE: 63.3%

MODEL: logistic_regression | 3 stratified folds | training rows per fold: about 2,666
| probabilities | ECE | ROC-AUC | Brier |
|---|---|---|---|
| raw | 0.0183 | 0.7994 | 0.1735 |
| sigmoid | 0.0265 | 0.7968 | 0.1756 |
| isotonic | 0.0326 | 0.7961 | 0.1763 |

ALLOWED ACTIONS: keep_uncalibrated | calibrate_sigmoid | calibrate_isotonic
(keep_uncalibrated | calibrate_sigmoid | calibrate_isotonic)

DECISION: keep_uncalibrated
WHY: Raw `logistic_regression` probabilities are already usable or calibration does not pay: raw ECE is 0.0183 (at or below the 0.03 bar). Adding a calibration layer would add complexity for no measured benefit.
RULE: DCLAB-R14 (probability quality, not ROC-AUC alone) and DCLAB-R18 (thresholds need trustworthy probabilities)
CONFIDENCE: high
NEXT: Lock the uncalibrated model and move to the final holdout check.
